components.title: MYLO Core
components.description: The always-on service the other parts talk to: persistent scheduling with retries and missed-run recovery, an event log, incident tracking, and notifications that connected apps pick up.

components.title: macOS Companion
components.description: A native SwiftUI app for macOS — tasks, reminders, and an inbox of what needs attention. A morning briefing view is in progress.

components.title: Scheduled tasks & reminders
components.description: Recurring and one-off schedules that respect time zones and daylight saving, with reminders you complete, snooze, or skip from the macOS app.

components.title: Monitoring
components.description: Monitors a single background automation: detects when it is interrupted, opens an incident, and tracks it through to recovery.

components.title: Integrations
components.description: Read-only connections to GitHub and GitLab, so review requests, failing CI pipelines, and merge conflicts land in MYLO's inbox.

components.title: Conversational AI via MCP
components.description: An MCP server lets an AI assistant create and manage MYLO's tasks in conversation, using the same scheduling rules as the app.
